name: Allowed registries
description: Fail workloads that pull images from registries or repositories outside the approved allow list.
long_description: ISM-1490 (partial): Scan and PolicyReport results show workload image and execution guardrails on Kubernetes servers; they do not prove host or endpoint application control. ISM-1657 (partial): Approved-image and workload-execution findings evidence the Kubernetes translation of application control; they do not inspect binaries inside images. ISM-1871 (partial): Cluster-wide workload findings show whether the Kubernetes translation is applied across scanned namespaces; they do not assess host filesystem locations.
remediation: Use an approved registry and provide the allow list through posture control inputs or the guided scan's cluster-managed registry ConfigMap.

provenance.rationale: The upstream rule provides the base allow-list behaviour; the local implementation also accepts the public Kyverno registry ConfigMap.
